shortHandedPolicy: Team SH goals divided by all recorded games played. SH sample labels use the SH minute cutoff independently of five-on-five eligibility. Recorded SH production is retained below the cutoff. No SH baseline or rating contribution is calculated.
defensiveContextPolicy: Lower against rates indicate fewer opposing events. Unblocked attempts against use reconstructed five-on-five time; goals against use even-strength time. Baselines currently reuse the existing five-on-five eligibility group for exploration. No defensive weights or player scores are assigned.
individualActionPolicy: Blocks and takeaways use all-situations event counts divided by total ice time from the timeonice report. Rates are expressed per 60 minutes. Their positional baselines reuse the existing five-on-five eligibility group for exploration. No action weights are assigned.
note: Includes team on-ice context and individual defensive actions. On-ice results are unadjusted for teammates, opponents and deployment. Five-on-five time is reconstructed from the summaryshooting per-game average. Individual actions use all-situations ice time.
